properties.displayName: UAV S20 - Failsafe Suppressed During Low Battery (Loss of Safety)
properties.description: 배터리 15% 이하(SYS_STATUS)인데 UAVFailsafe_CL에 RTL/LAND 이벤트 없음 — Failsafe 억제 의심. MITRE: T0880 Loss of Safety
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
let battThreshold = 15;
let BattLow =
    UAVTelemetry_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where MsgType == 'SYS_STATUS'
    | where BatteryRemaining_pct < battThreshold
    | project T_batt=TimeGenerated, UAVId;
let FailsafeEvent =
    UAVFailsafe_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where ModeAfter in ('RTL','LAND','QRTL','QLAND')
    | project T_fs=TimeGenerated, UAVId;
BattLow
| join kind=leftanti (FailsafeEvent) on UAVId
| summarize LowBattCount=count(), FirstLow=min(T_batt) by UAVId
| where LowBattCount > 3
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("배터리_", tostring(battThreshold), "%_이하_Failsafe_미발동_억제의심_", tostring(LowBattCount), "회")
| extend Severity = "High"
| project FirstLow, UAVId, LowBattCount, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by FirstLow desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S20 - Failsafe Suppressed During Low Battery (Loss of Safety) - {{UAVId}}
